verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a ledger-based (prefunded) balance model with real-time tracking and offers 'collaborative authorization' letting a client system approve/decline each transaction in real time, which functions like JIT-style authorization logic. However, there is no explicit documentation framing 'prefunded vs just-in-time funding' as a discrete choice, nor any cash-flow tradeoff discussion between the two models — funding routes (push-to-card, RTP, ACH) are mentioned but not tied to a JIT funding decision. Missing for 10: explicit JIT funding option/terminology, side-by-side cash-flow tradeoff documentation, guidance on choosing between prefunded and JIT models.
